# `potential.define`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/potential.define.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`potential.define`: names and types a potential at a CP or a junction (FR-CON-010).

Creates `PotentialDef {at, name, ptype, voltage, env, circuit_class, props}`. `at` must be a CP of an
existing function or an existing junction (a point on a connection is rejected). Outcome: the
definition.

## Types

### CircuitClass

Circuit classes (doc 03 §9.1, FR-CON-022).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"mains"` | Mains. |
| `"control"` | Control. |
| `"analogue"` | Analogue. |
| `"bus"` | Bus. |
| `"pe"` | Protective earth. |

### CmdDec3

A canonical decimal string with at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros and no unit (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at most 21 character(s))

Pattern: `^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,15}(?:\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])?|-?0\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])$`

### CmdIdent

An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### EndpointParam

An endpoint named in command parameters: a function CP, a junction, or a point on an existing
connection (which splits it and creates a junction there, doc 06 §3.5).

JSON: `{"cp": {"function": "…", "idx": 1}}`, `{"junction": {"junction": "…"}}`,
`{"on_connection": {"connection": "…", "at": [x, y]}}`.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: Connection point `idx` of a function.

   Shape: object { `cp`: object { `function`: [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid), `idx`: integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) } }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `cp` | object { `function`: [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid), `idx`: integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) } | yes |  |  |

2. **Form 2**: A junction.

   Shape: object { `junction`: object { `junction`: [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) } }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `junction` | object { `junction`: [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) } | yes |  |  |

3. **Form 3**: A point on an existing connection's route.

   Shape: object { `on_connection`: object { `at`: [`CmdPt2`](#cmdpt2), `connection`: [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) } }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `on_connection` | object { `at`: [`CmdPt2`](#cmdpt2), `connection`: [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) } | yes |  |  |

### CmdPt2

A point or a displacement [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### AcDc

AC or DC.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"ac"` | Alternating current. |
| `"dc"` | Direct current. |

### Dec3

A canonical decimal string: at most three fraction digits, no trailing fraction zeros, no leading zeros, no plus sign, no "-0", no exponent, no white space, no unit (doc 05 §3.2). The pattern bounds the integer part to 16 digits; the exact i64 range of the thousandths (about 9.2 x 10^15) is checked by the reader.

Type: string (at most 21 character(s))

Pattern: `^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]{0,15}(?:\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])?|-?0\.[0-9]{0,2}[1-9])$`

### PotentialEarthing

Earthing of an extra-low-voltage potential.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"pelv"` | Protective extra-low voltage. |
| `"selv"` | Safety extra-low voltage. |
| `"floating"` | Floating. |

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
